title: Inverter Subgroup INV-07 to INV-09 Underperformance
description: Three inverters in Block C showing 12% below expected output. Suspected MPPT tracking fault.
root_cause: Firmware bug in MPPT algorithm causing tracking loss at high irradiance
resolution: Firmware update applied; performance restored to baseline within 48 hours

title: Network Gateway Communication Loss
description: LTE modem failure caused 72-hour data gap. Failover to satellite incomplete.
root_cause: Cradlepoint IBR1700 SIM card failure; satellite failover config error
resolution: Replaced SIM card, corrected satellite failover configuration

title: Tropical Storm Hilary Remnants - High Wind Event
description: Sustained winds 55+ mph with gusts to 72 mph. Tracker stow activated. 4 trackers stuck in stow.
root_cause: Extreme wind event exceeding design limits for tracker actuators
resolution: Manual tracker reset, 2 actuator motor replacements, full inspection of all rows

title: Preventive Maintenance Cost Reduction Initiative
description: Implemented predictive maintenance scheduling reducing unplanned downtime by 40%
root_cause: Optimization of preventive maintenance intervals using historical failure data
resolution: Revised PM schedule adopted; corrective maintenance budget reduced 22% QoQ

title: Inverter INV-05 IGBT Module Failure - Warranty Replacement
description: Complete IGBT module failure in Inverter 05. Covered under manufacturer warranty.
root_cause: Manufacturing defect in IGBT gate driver
resolution: Sungrow dispatched replacement unit under warranty; installed within 5 business days
